Responding here [@Shankar Warang](/edgeware/account/jA7pLH65zgRNA4UgwqHEWWRxTgg51wuAUgfzmZoYWM2dMVS) (would be better if we could thread more than one comment on a future forum to continue a converstion).

> As treasury is eliminated from the snapshot, Convertible Note Grants could be the simplest way for Edgeware Treasury to have KAB in future. As Edgeware and Kabocha have the shared community, this could be refined, discussed and executed after the launch only thus resulting in no added complexity in the current process. 

Of course we can continue this discussion, the Edgeware community is the Kabocha community plus new people so its not like we're gonna suddenly be different... it should be a longer and more in depth conversation focused on value capture in EDG / KAB and future chains. 

> As Decentration and Decent Partners will have significant network share in Kabocha, can you assure the community that Convertible Note Grants' reimbursement proposals to Kabocha treasury for all [supplementary grants](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/3670-convertible-note-grants-a-new-funding-type-idea-for-the-chainprotocol-factory-model) will not be blocked in future? 

Given EDG distribution, Decent Partners will be a minority stakeholder. There will be a number of other groups who control much more than Decentration. 

I would also say that the idea and the implementation of the Convertible note grants is still very high level and so I'd never say we 'must' do this or that, in the end, Kabocha will be led by the community, so practically speaking we can't 'block' anything, it's up to whoever puts forward proposals / structures to make a strong case for them and have them pass votes. 

We need to stop seeing this as a zero sum game - these are not 'supplementary' grants, these are grants that fund the development and launch of Edgeware's sister chain - Kabocha, it's like seeing one upgrade as competitive to another... Edgeware IS Kabocha and will unlock a whole heap of things that will in turn return value to Edgeware as we go.

body: This guy has worked with Little Simz! Great visuals!

[@Decent Partners](/edgeware/account/ks9tY4vnb5oEGsj5QyrJ1Z66ydjMbjhy623zMBdnCigfGAk), would you like to explore the possibility of proposing 'Kabocha visuals and crowdloan NFTs' as the first Convertible Note Grant: [https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/3670-convertible-note-grants-a-new-funding-type-idea-for-the-chainprotocol-factory-model](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/3670-convertible-note-grants-a-new-funding-type-idea-for-the-chainprotocol-factory-model) ?
The framework definitely needs feedback to fine-tune the parameters.
(The on-chain governance process remains the same.)

See my comment on the main post... right now Edgeware is getting a huge amount of value via the 1:1 snapshot, not sure there is a need to add this into the mix, think the concept works better elsewhere and it will need more refining so better to get Kabocha up and running and then figure out stuff. 

One thought... 

- Edgeware treasury could receive **a genesis NFT**, the seed from which all other seeds are born. Even this is quite difficult, given we haven't upgraded the network with the pallets we'll need to enable the RMRK level stuff.

> Edgeware treasury could receive **a genesis NFT**
I would personally love to see 'could' (possibility) getting replaced with 'will' (certainty). 

> right now Edgeware is getting a huge amount of value via the 1:1 snapshot
*Edgeware -> EDG holders
As treasury is eliminated from the snapshot, Convertible Note Grants could be the simplest way for Edgeware Treasury to have KAB in future. As Edgeware and Kabocha have the shared community, this could be refined, discussed and executed after the launch only thus resulting in no added complexity in the current process. 
As Decentration and Decent Partners will have significant network share in Kabocha, can you assure the community that Convertible Note Grants' reimbursement proposals to Kabocha treasury for all [supplementary grants](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/3670-convertible-note-grants-a-new-funding-type-idea-for-the-chainprotocol-factory-model) will not be blocked in future?
Is it possible to share the criteria for the crowdloan NFTs?
Will do on a post about the crowdloan strategy soon
